subtitle: Lesson 7 · Debits and Credits

eyebrow: Dunmore Office Partners · example, not real data
code:
Pay $300 cash for supplies:
  Debit  Supplies        $300
  Credit Cash                     $300

Bill a client $2,500 on account:
  Debit  Accounts Receivable  $2,500
  Credit Service Revenue              $2,500
caption: No cash moved in the second entry - the receivable captures the promise.
Cash (asset) increases; the obligation to repay (liability) increases too.
